name: lipgloss-terminal-control-sequence-trust-policy
instr:
Lip Gloss cannot consistently preserve, neutralize, or reject terminal control sequences in untrusted text across its rendering families. Add policy-aware rendering before layout while trusting library formatting and leaving existing entry points and explicit preserve mode unchanged.

Export `ControlMode`, `ControlPolicy`, `DefaultControlPolicy`, `ControlResult`, `ControlSpan`, `ControlError`, `ControlPolicy.Apply`, `Style.RenderPolicy`, `FprintPolicy`, `Layer.RenderPolicy`, `Compositor.RenderPolicy`, `Canvas.ComposePolicy`, and `Canvas.RenderPolicy` from `charm.land/lipgloss/v2`. Define `ControlPreserve`, `ControlNeutralize`, and `ControlReject` in that iota order. Deterministically preserve printable Unicode and malformed fragments, neutralize recognized controls before measurement, or reject the first disallowed control by source byte order without accepted output.

`ControlResult` has `Text` and `Spans`. `ControlSpan` and `ControlError` report `Start` and `End` byte offsets. Apply policies only to supplied values. Trust library-produced colors, hyperlinks, borders, padding, margins, wrapping, enumerators, indenters, bullets, and style callbacks.

Export `Table.RenderPolicy`, `TableControlError`, and `New` from `table`. Preserve rectangular Data semantics and Filter projection, including sparse cells and visible-coordinate reporting. `TableControlError` reports `Row`, `Column`, and `Cause`, using `HeaderRow` or zero-based visible coordinates in traversal order.
